title: Verification Record
description: A verification record binds the commands that prove a fixture, a CI job or a rule to the output they must print. One record per file, spec/extras/verification/ver-<id>.json, written by the toolkit and never by hand. The file holds a records array of exactly one record, and the file name without .json is the record id.

records.description: The one verification record of this file.

items.description: A verification record: what it verifies, at which stage, the commands to run and the guard the output must match.

verification_id.description: Id of this record: ver- followed by a kebab-case name. Equals the file name without .json.

verifies.description: Ids of the fixtures, CI jobs or rules these commands prove.

stage.description: Stage at which the commands run: dev, ci, staging or prod. Default dev. Evidence from a later stage on the same code tree also satisfies an earlier stage, never the reverse.

commands.description: The commands to run, each a shell command line. At least one.

output_guard.description: A regular expression the output of the commands must match. It is the only protection against a command that exits 0 having run nothing, so it is required; use the test's own name or a line only a real run prints.
